messages:
Mira: quick favor — can someone run a small-batch cold-start microbench for the fused flash+paged ops PR (sha: a1b2c3d)? seeing intermittent tail latency spikes at seq=80 on T4s. can we get nvtx + kernel traces + vmstat?

Mira: command I used locally (please run from /srv/bench):
```
./run_bench.sh --model=redwood-small --op=fused-flash-paged --seq=80 --batch=1 --iter=20 --nvtx --out=artifacts/a1b2c3d/seq80.json --coldstart
export FLASH_FUSE=1
```

Mira: also please include the exact docker image tag and commit SHA in the artifact metadata. thanks :pray:

Jake: on it, queuing on t4-pool1 now. ETA ~25m. will attach nvprof and nvtx.

infra-bot: scheduled bench job id=11234 on t4-pool1. workspace=/srv/bench/jobs/11234. logs -> https://internal/infra/logs/11234.txt

Ben: fyi i've seen a similar tail at batch=2 on a different branch — could be kv-cache eviction thrash. if possible capture `vmstat 1` during the run and sample `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` for the PID.

Sophia: i reproduced a lighter spike on A100 devbox. kernel launch stack points to fused_attention.cu:243 (malloc+memset path). short trace:
```
[fused_attention] launch at fused_attention.cu:243
  grid=(128,1,1) block=(256,1,1) shared=8192
  time=1.42ms  (hot)
  time=12.9ms (cold)
```

Sophia: proposal: try reusing a pinned buffer (avoid per-invocation memset) or set env `KERNELOPT_ZERO=false` to test.

Jake: job 11234 finished. artifacts uploaded: https://internal/bench/a1b2c3d/11234/nvtx.json , https://internal/bench/a1b2c3d/11234/nvprof.tar.gz , https://internal/bench/a1b2c3d/11234/vmstat.txt

Ben: vmstat snippet from that run:
```
procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- ------cpu-----
 r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st
 2  0      0  102400  1200  523000    0    0     5    10  150  180 10  5 80 5 0
```

DevOps: storage bump for /srv/bench/artifacts completed (quota +20GB) — Jake, artifacts retained for 14d.

Alex: quick CR note — the fused kernel zeroes a scratch buffer on each call (line ~238). i pushed a tiny change to reuse the buffer across invocations (PR: https://internal/git/reds/patches/423). should be safe but needs perf validation.

Mira: perfect. prioritize a re-run after Alex's PR merges. if reuse removes the cold tail we can consider canary unblocked. marking this thread blocking for the canary rollout. :eyes:

Jake: ack — i'll re-run after merge and paste new artifacts here.

Mira: thanks everyone — please drop any followups here instead of DMs so we keep the traces together.
